descriptionMarkdown:
Power Tag Rule
Warp Spark Universal Action. Range 60 ft. Psychic attack. On hit, 1d8 force damage.
Kinetic Push Telekinesis, Universal Action. Range 30 ft. Strength save. Failure: pushed 10 ft and takes 1d6 force damage.
Mind Lumen Divination, Universal Bonus Action. Self. 10 minutes. See psychic traces, Warp residue, emotional 
impressions, and unnatural disturbances within 30 ft.
Static Veil Telekinesis, Universal Reaction. Trigger: targeted by a ranged attack. Add +2 AC against that attack.
Flesh Knit Biomancy Action. Touch. A creature regains 1d6 + psychic ability modifier HP.
Pain Spike Biomancy Action. Range 60 ft. Constitution save. Failure: 1d8 psychic damage, and the target 
cannot take reactions.
Ember Flicker Pyromancy Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. Ignite or extinguish a small flame; one creature takes 1 fire 
damage if holding a flammable object.
Power Tag Rule
Ashen Brand Pyromancy Action. Range: 60 ft. Psychic attack. On hit, 1d8 fire/radiant damage, and the target 
sheds dim light until your next turn.
Danger Sense Divination Reaction. When you roll initiative, add 1d4 to your initiative roll.
Echo Read Divination Action. Touch an object or corpse. Learn one recent strong emotion, danger, or image 
attached to it.
Whisper from Below Malefic Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. One creature makes a Wisdom save. Failure: disadvantage 
on the next Wisdom saving throw before your next turn.
Warp Bite Malefic Action. Range 60 ft. Psychic attack. On hit, 1d10 psychic damage. If you roll a natural 
1, immediately add +1 Warp Pressure.
Null Glare Null Action. Range 30 ft. One creature makes a Charisma save. Failure: it has 
disadvantage on the next psychic attack roll it makes, or the next saving throw it 
forces, before your next turn.
Blank Sense Null Bonus Action. Self. 10 minutes. Sense active psychic effects, daemonic influence, 
blanks, and Warp residue within 30 ft.
